courses.title: Binary numbers
courses.description: Read and write whole numbers from 0 to 255 in binary.

skills.title: Reading binary numbers
skills.description: Turn a binary number into decimal by adding place values.

skills.title: Writing numbers in binary
skills.description: Turn a decimal number into binary.

lessons.title: Reading binary numbers
Writing numbers in binary

payload.prompt: What is the binary number 101 in decimal?

hints.text: Each place is worth twice the place to its right: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 and so on. Add the places that hold a 1.

items.explanation: The 1s of 101 are worth 4 + 1, which makes 5.

misconceptionFeedback.reversed-bits: Binary is written like decimal: the place worth the most is on the left, and the 1s place is on the right.
misconceptionFeedback.read-as-decimal: The 1s and 0s are bits, not a decimal number: add up the place values that hold a 1.
misconceptionFeedback.counted-ones: Each 1 is worth its place value (1, 2, 4, 8, …), not just 1.
